hints.en: Fill the table as in the `knapsack` exercise.

hints.tr: `chosen, w = [], capacity`; `for i in range(n, 0, -1):` içinde `best[i][w] != best[i - 1][w]` ise `chosen.append(i - 1)` ve `w -= items[i - 1][1]`.
hints.en: `chosen, w = [], capacity`; inside `for i in range(n, 0, -1):`, if `best[i][w] != best[i - 1][w]`, `chosen.append(i - 1)` and `w -= items[i - 1][1]`.
